title: Governance
subtitle: Demo ruleset history, audit log, access reports and simulation, and access grant configuration.
tamperNote: Demo audit logs show expected behaviour but do not prove tamper resistance.
demoRule: Illustrative demo placeholder — requires clinical approval

offline.title: You are offline (demo)
offline.body: Governance data cannot be refreshed and changes cannot be saved until the connection returns.

rulesets.title: Demo ruleset history
rulesets.subtitle: Every version of the demo flagging rules, with how many in-scope screenings were evaluated under it. Rules are read-only here: changes are clinical-governance decisions.
rulesets.error: The ruleset history could not be loaded.
rulesets.reasonCodes: Reason codes this version can give
rulesets.thresholdsHidden: Threshold values are not shown: they are illustrative placeholders, never approved clinical values.

changeSummary.initial_placeholders: First set of illustrative demo placeholders (blood pressure and glucose).
changeSummary.placeholders_revised: Placeholders revised; incomplete glucose context now routed to a human reviewer.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Read-only. Newest first, 25 per page. Patient-linked events show opaque ids only; clinical free text stays with the record.
audit.caption: Audit events
audit.error: The audit log could not be loaded.
audit.emptyHint: Change or clear the filters to see more events.
audit.showChain: Show only the events of correlation {{id}}
audit.chainFilter: Showing the chain of correlation id {{id}}.

sim.title: Access simulation
sim.subtitle: Can a demo persona see a resource? Uses the same decision function as the real route and repository checks.
sim.rule: Rule: {{persona}} acts as {{role}}; required capability {{permission}}; scope from the persona's access grant.

reason.OK: Allowed: the role holds the capability and the resource is inside the grant.
reason.MISSING_CAPABILITY: Denied: this persona's role does not hold the required capability
reason.GRANT_EXPIRED: Denied: this persona's access grant has expired or was revoked
reason.OUT_OF_SCOPE_DISTRICT: Denied: district is outside this persona's scope
reason.OUT_OF_SCOPE_FACILITY: Denied: facility is outside this persona's scope

sim.tryItHint: Switches the demo session to the chosen persona and opens the District Beta overview, so you see the real 403 page and its audit event.
sim.tryIt: Try as {{persona}}: open District Beta overview
sim.tryItSelf: This is your current persona: District Beta may be inside your own scope.
sim.returnBanner: Demo role switch: you are trying the app as {{persona}} (started by {{original}}).

roles.title: Access grants
roles.subtitle: Reporting scope and role of each demo admin persona. Grants are never deleted; every change is versioned and audited.
roles.error: The access grants could not be loaded.
roles.readOnly: Read only: only the programme lead (roles.configure) can change access grants.
roles.historyEmpty: No changes recorded (or not visible in your scope).
roles.historyError: The version history could not be loaded.

conflict.title: This grant was changed by someone else
conflict.description: Compare your version with the latest one, then keep the latest or re-apply your change on top of it.

demo.staleArmed: The next save of this grant will meet a newer version (demo).
